findings.evidence: AEMO 2026 ISP reports proponent timing of December 2034 for Stage 2 and December 2030 for the anticipated Stage 1. The chart carries the later stage only, so the row's date does not describe when the first 750 MW link operates, and neither date is an actual completion.

No archived source states $5.5 billion for any Project Marinus boundary. For the chart's own boundary (Marinus Link 1 & 2) AEMO's 2026 feedback-loop assessment reports a total project cost of $7,570 million in $2023. Separately stated observations range from $3,481m (2021 PACR, $2020) to $5,035m Stage 1 plus $2,535m Stage 2 ($2023). NWTD ($1,144m plus $525m) is excluded from these figures. Separately, the September 2025 joint ministerial release reports $3.8bn CEFC funding secured for Stage 1 at financial close, alongside unstated equity commitments from the Commonwealth, Tasmania and Victoria; this is a funding/debt figure for Stage 1 only, not a total project cost, and does not state $5.5bn for any boundary either.
findings.pages: HUM-AEMO-2026-ISP-A5 p59; ML-TN-2025-RITT p18; HUM-AEMO-2024-ISP-A5 p37; ML-TN-2021-PACR p16; ML-DCCEEW-2025-FID web
findings.supported_value: 7570 AUD million in $2023 (Stage 1 $5,035m plus Stage 2 $2,535m, as reported by AEMO)

findings.evidence: Every archived planner and proponent source states 1,500 MW, not 1,400 MW. AEMO separately reports directional combined transfer limits with Basslink of 1,728 MW (VIC to TAS) and 2,094 MW (TAS to VIC), so 1.4 GW matches neither the nameplate nor a stated transfer limit.
findings.supported_value: 1.5 GW (1,500 MW nameplate, as two 750 MW HVDC links)

findings.evidence: 345 is the sum of ML-AO-2025-LENGTH-SUBSEA (255 km) and ML-AO-2025-LENGTH-UNDERGROUND (90 km). No archived source states a combined 345 km figure, and both components are approximate HVDC cable lengths, not the chart's definition of distance rated at 500 kV. The 220 kV NWTD line lengths are not stated in any archived source.
findings.supported_value: 255 km subsea HVDC cable and 90 km underground HVDC cable in Victoria, stated separately

findings.evidence: A workbook formula dividing the cost cell by the trunk length cell. Both inputs are unsupported or derived: the cost cell is contradicted (see cost_aud_billion) and the length cell is the sum of ML-AO-2025-LENGTH-SUBSEA and ML-AO-2025-LENGTH-UNDERGROUND. No archived source publishes a cost per kilometre for Project Marinus.
AEMO describes two 750 MW HVDC developments. These are HVDC monopoles, not the new parallel 500 kV AC circuits the chart's definition names, so the count agrees while the definition does not.

The chart counts lines of towers. Marinus Link is subsea and underground cable, so the two stages are two cable routes rather than two tower lines. The 220 kV NWTD works do involve overhead lines, but they sit in a separate delivery boundary and are not counted here.
findings.supported_value: 2 HVDC cable routes (subsea and underground), no transmission-line towers for the interconnector

findings.evidence: Geographic route diversity is an author definition that no archived source supplies. Sources establish that Marinus Link operates in parallel with the existing Basslink interconnector across Bass Strait, which is the fact the author's count would rest on; the count of 2 remains the author's.
No archived source states synchronous condenser capacity within the Project Marinus or NWTD scope. The zero is not contradicted, but it is not evidenced either.

No archived source counts hubs for Project Marinus. The scope names converter stations at Burnie and Hazelwood and switching stations at Heybridge and Staverton; whether any of these count as a hub under the chart's definition is the author's decision.

No archived source states committed or actionable transformer capacity for Project Marinus. The delivery scope names HVDC converter stations, whose rating AEMO reports as link capacity rather than transformer MVA.

The 2026 ISP describes 220 kV NWTD works (Sheffield-Heybridge-Burnie, Palmerston-Sheffield, Staverton-Hampshire, Sheffield-Staverton) that meet the chart's definition of lower-voltage lines connecting to the main trunk, but no archived source states their length. The zero is therefore unsupported rather than confirmed.

policy_chart.overall_status: The row should not be published as-is: the cost and capacity cells are contradicted by archived sources, the length and ratio cells are derivations under a definition Marinus does not meet, and five topology cells are gaps or author judgments.

summary.analysis_conclusion: Published amounts are discrete observations with different scope, price, maturity and sunk-cost treatment. They do not establish a simple cost-overrun series or one reconciled current total.
summary.capacity: Two staged 750 MW monopole HVDC links (1,500 MW total), operating alongside Basslink.
summary.current_status: Stage 1 anticipated following the reported 1 August 2025 government FID; Stage 2 actionable and reassessed.
summary.delivery_status: Stage 1 anticipated project (AEMO 2026 ISP); Stage 2 reassessed as an actionable ISP project (TAS-SEV Option 2A). No construction outturn captured.
summary.dependent_projects: Tasmania REZ Expansion (T2 Option 1) builds the Burnie-Hampshire Hills 220 kV lines removed from Stage 2 Option 2A; North West Transmission Developments (TasNetworks); existing Basslink interconnector operates in parallel.
summary.funding_pathway: Actionable ISP project under the RIT-T, feedback-loop and contingent-project framework. AEMO reports a Tasmanian, Victorian and Australian government Final Investment Decision for Stage 1 on 1 August 2025; the operative decision or funding instrument is not archived.
summary.identity: One provisional Project Marinus; Stage 1 and Stage 2 are separate components/versions pending lifecycle review.
summary.name: Project Marinus
summary.owner: Marinus Link Pty Ltd delivers the HVDC interconnector; TasNetworks delivers the North West Transmission Developments (NWTD) HVAC works. AEMO reports both collectively as Project Marinus.
summary.schedule: Stage 1: December 2030. Stage 2 proponent timing: December 2034.

warnings.finding: The chart's 345 km trunk length is the sum of two separately stated approximate HVDC cable lengths (255 km subsea, 90 km underground), and Millions/trunk KM is a workbook formula over that sum and the contradicted cost cell.

warnings.finding: Three definitions are the author's to settle: whether any inclusive cost view (Project Marinus plus NWTD) may be published; whether an HVDC cable route counts as trunk kilometres when the chart defines trunk as distance rated at 500 kV; and how alt routes and hubs are counted for a subsea interconnector.
warnings.implication: Until the author decides, the cost cell stays at the source-defined boundary, the trunk cell stays marked as derived, and alt_routes and hubs stay marked as judgments.
